info.name: HRM - Training / LMS
info.description:
Company Admin / HR manage training materials (video or PDF) via /training. Employees (real login, not the onboarding token) view them via /employee-training and mark them complete via /employee-training/complete, which sets employees.lms_completed_at.

This matters for employees activated through the onboarding invite flow (see Employee_Onboarding_Invite_Flow.postman_collection.json, step 6 Activate) — they get employees.lms_required = true, and the frontend hides the rest of the Employee Portal behind the Learning tab until lms_completed_at is set. Employees added directly (Add Employee) are unaffected.

Uploads for training files go through the dedicated POST /uploads/training-file endpoint (not /uploads/image) — it accepts PDF or common video mimetypes and allows up to 300MB.

Permissions: Company Admin has access to everything by default. HR Manager and Employee system-template roles were auto-granted `training` / `employee_training` permissions respectively when this module was deployed (existing custom access roles may need it granted manually via Roles & Permissions).

Run order: 0) Login (Company Admin) → Admin folder: 1) Upload Training File → 2) Create Training Material → 3) List → 4) Get By Id → 5) Update → 6) Delete. Employee folder: 0b) Login (Employee, real credentials from an activated account) → 7) List My Training Materials → 8) Mark My Training Complete.

Set `base_url` before running (default assumes local dev on port 3002).

request.description: Convenience login to obtain a Company Admin Bearer token. Fills admin_token and company_id automatically.

Public endpoint, no Authorization needed — same pattern as /uploads/image but a separate multer config with a much higher size limit (300MB) and a different mimetype allowlist: application/pdf, video/mp4, video/webm, video/quicktime, video/x-msvideo.

Pick a PDF or video file for the 'file' form field. The returned file_url is what you pass into Create/Update Training Material below.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Company Code of Conduct",
  "description": "An overview of our workplace policies and expectations.",
  "type": "pdf",
  "file_url": "{{uploaded_file_url}}",
  "file_name": "{{uploaded_file_name}}"
}

request.description: company_id is taken from the admin's own token — not a request field. `type` must be "video" or "pdf". `name` and `file_url` are required; `description` and `file_name` are optional.
Company-scoped list (from the admin's token), newest first. Optional `search` matches on name; `no_pagination=true` returns the full list.
Any of name, description, type, file_url, file_name, is_active may be included — only the fields present are updated. Setting is_active: false has the same effect as Delete (soft delete).
Soft delete (is_active = false) — the record stays for any employee who already completed training, but it drops off the employee-facing list and the admin list unless you add an is_active filter.

Use the login email + temporary password an employee received after Activate Employee (see Employee_Onboarding_Invite_Flow.postman_collection.json step 6) — these endpoints need a real login session, not the onboarding token. Fills employee_access_token automatically.

Returns training_materials[] (id, name, description, type, file_url, file_name) for this employee's company, plus lms_required and lms_completed_at so the frontend knows whether to show the completion gate.
Sets employees.lms_completed_at (first call only — idempotent, later calls keep the original timestamp). Once set, the frontend unlocks the rest of the Employee Portal.
